title: The fixed derived scalar oplax structure and its unit
statement: The generic derived oplax structure on the fixed scalar functor D has its unit equal to derivedScalarUnit; this unit is invertible.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YY, 0G7E, 07A4, 07A6; sites-modules.tex Tags 03EK and 03EL. Extracted from lem-sfb-quotient-section-tensor-normalization.

proof.text: Use the generic left-derived oplax structure of the ordinary strong monoidal scalar extension. Unfold its tensor and unit fields. The cochain and homotopy unit formulas identify the explicit localization-unit composite; the generic K-flat unit theorem proves its invertibility. Splitting these definitional identifications keeps kernel checking within the per-file limit.
